accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:uniform-linearization, thm:conditional-multiplier, and thm:uniform-regret
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Path-uniform interiority, three-times differentiable criterion regularity, and a uniform curvature floor are maintained rather than derived from FangRidderXie2026's fixed-penalty assumptions.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Uniform frontier, multiplier, and regret conclusions are conditional on ass:uniform-interior, ass:smooth-criterion, and ass:uniform-curvature over the fixed positive compact penalty interval.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 17--18, Theorems 1--2; p. 25, Theorem 5; p. 32, application scaling
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorems 1 and 5 give fixed-penalty efficient optimizer inference and efficient quadratic regret; Theorem 2 gives the fixed-penalty quadratic-regret law. The application writes lambda=c times the welfare scale, so a direct-penalty coordinate lambda maps to the reported normalized preference lambda/s_W.
The paper develops simultaneous confidence bands for function-valued moment-condition parameters using approximately Neyman-orthogonal scores and an estimated-score multiplier bootstrap.
The manuscript proposes risk-aware policy selection with a reporting guarantee for delivered welfare; it does not state the present softmax-frontier process.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Promote the finite-action sufficient-condition routes for path-uniform interiority and curvature into an explicit primitive theorem, rather than leaving them as explanatory routes attached to maintained assumptions.
State an implementable finite-grid interpolation error and a simulation-ready covariance/critical-value algorithm, so the continuous-path tube has an auditable numerical counterpart.
Develop the local-to-zero penalty transition seed, where uniform curvature fails and the rate/limit changes; this would move the project beyond a regular compact-path extension.

recommended_next_step: Advance to Stage 0 with the field-tier kernel: prove the foldwise same-sample-path replacement bound before treating the uniform frontier and regret corollaries as established.
